This is a research proposal for the independent experimental fork. It does not
establish support or authorize flashing. Read the repository's disclaimer and
hardware roadmap, then use the full board proposal template in
`docs/community/BOARD_PROPOSAL.md`.

## Model and requested work

- Retail model/generation:
- Public model marking and board revision:
- Requested research or contribution:
- Test hardware availability:

## Evidence and unknowns

Link dated sources or sanitized photographs for the SoC, storage, boot chain,
recovery route and audio/microphone hardware. Identify unknowns explicitly.
Do not infer compatibility from appearance, a USB connection or a shared SoC.

## Proposed repository changes

Describe the expected Product, Linux, Platform and UI work. A different SoC
requires architecture/schema/tooling work before adding a target descriptor.
New ports remain unaccepted until their exact build passes physical testing.

## Acceptance plan and AI disclosure

Describe host/CI and physical hardware checks separately. State whether AI
tools assisted the research or proposed implementation and how claims were
verified. Link component issues or pull requests if they exist.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I read the disclaimer and understand there is no promised completed port,
  recovery, repair, replacement or support service.
- [ ] I removed serial numbers, MAC addresses, credentials and private network details.
- [ ] I have permission to share every attached file; no private signing keys or owner-only firmware dumps are included.
- [ ] Verified facts, assumptions, failures and unknowns are clearly separated.
